theory.intro: A full turn is $360^{\circ}$, so two angles that differ by a whole number of turns point in exactly the same direction. Any angle can be rewritten as an equivalent angle with $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
facts: A full revolution is $360^{\circ}$, so adding or subtracting $360^{\circ}$ never changes the direction an angle points.
Two angles are **coterminal** (equivalent) when they differ by a whole number of $360^{\circ}$ turns.
An angle that reduces to exactly $360^{\circ}$ is rewritten as $0^{\circ}$, because $360^{\circ}$ is outside the range and points the same way.

workedExamples.question_text: Rewrite $425^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $-125^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $-850^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Add $360^{\circ}$ repeatedly until the angle is in the required range.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-850^{\circ}\\&\equiv-850^{\circ}+360^{\circ}\\&\equiv-490^{\circ}\\&\equiv-490^{\circ}+360^{\circ}\\&\equiv-130^{\circ}\\&\equiv-130^{\circ}+360^{\circ}\\&\equiv230^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: Rewrite $1440^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Subtract $360^{\circ}$ repeatedly.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}1440^{\circ}\\&\equiv1440^{\circ}-360^{\circ}\\&\equiv1080^{\circ}\\&\equiv1080^{\circ}-360^{\circ}\\&\equiv720^{\circ}\\&\equiv720^{\circ}-360^{\circ}\\&\equiv360^{\circ}\\&\equiv360^{\circ}-360^{\circ}\\&\equiv0^{\circ}\end{aligned}$
Continue past $360^{\circ}$ because the upper endpoint is excluded; $0^{\circ}$ is included.

A wheel turns through $930^{\circ}$ from its starting position.
Rewrite this as an angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$ to describe its final position.
development.solution_text:
$930^{\circ}$
$\equiv 930^{\circ}-360^{\circ}$
$\equiv 570^{\circ}$
$\equiv 570^{\circ}-360^{\circ}$
$\equiv 210^{\circ}$
The wheel finishes at the $210^{\circ}$ position.

practice.masteryOmitted: Single-step reduction atom: add or subtract $360^{\circ}$ until the angle lands in $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$. Larger magnitudes only repeat the same step, and coterminal recognition is already covered in the practice tiers, so there is no deeper in-skill twist.
